stage: Real-data numerical checks, UI boundaries and provenance scaling

build.type: Incremental build from verified alpha.3 source; recursive qmake regeneration and version-bearing object rebuild

real_data.source_integrity: Generator and C++ loader verify bundled source hashes; citations, license and chronology retained in fixture.
preparation: ODP 846: production preprocess fixed 1 ka with sort/duplicate averaging/linear interpolation, checked independently against NumPy.
ODP 926: explicitly prepared common 5 ka overlap grid in fixture. Native independently resampled records have different lengths and are rejected.
real_data.notation: segment samples / overlap samples / FFT length

acceptance_tolerances.spectrum_absolute: 3e-10 * max(abs(reference), 1e-3 * peak) + 1e-300; complex components also use magnitude peak

real_data.zero_frequency_exception: Raw SciPy references remain unchanged. Rectangular detrending DC has only floating residual power; Aster enforces analytic zero powers and undefined coherence/phase rather than comparing ratios of residuals.
real_data.interpretation: Software regression only; no significance, causal lead/lag or independent astronomical forcing claim from tuned age models.

new_interface_coverage: ODP 846 source/preprocess/pair: preview and formal serial/parallel outputs identical through database reload.
PT-ZB18a same-source obliquity/precession ports: actual A/B preview units and values, pair output and stored output agree.
Scoped manifest decodes, reconstructs workflow/grouping and reproduces paired output plus ordinary descendant; unrelated pair and branch omitted.
Four SQLite late-write failure cases: source/pair at concurrency 1/4; retained results retry with original UUID and exact output bytes.
Cancellation requested from actual segment-computation progress; cancelled record saved without invented output.
Undefined coherence to positive auto-B: logarithmic style restored and PNG export succeeds.
4/64/128 groups with shared last-position reference; pair provenance remains bounded for fixed workflow/source metadata.

fixes.issue: Every pair repeated the full batch manifest, producing quadratic serialized provenance growth.
fixes.resolution: Index jobs/datasets by identity; store the pair dependency subgraph and descendants. Full manifest API remains available.

fixes.issue: Restored log style was validated against the currently displayed metric rather than its requested metric.
fixes.resolution: Check positivity for the incoming cross-spectrum metric before applying the style.

fixes.issue: Rectangular detrending left tiny floating DC residuals with arbitrary coherence/phase.
fixes.resolution: Explicit analytic zero at DC only for rectangular mean/linear detrending. Method version 2; no amplitude threshold elsewhere.

performance.conditions: Synthetic 512-sample inputs; 64-sample segments, overlap 32, concurrent jobs 4. One shared reference, ordinary sources and paired records included. Before=alpha.3; after=current test run.
performance.interpretation: Single-run local measurements, not hardware benchmarks or general dataset size guarantees. Database/provenance byte counts demonstrate removed duplication; wall times vary with host load.

sanitizer.configuration: AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer; Debug instrumented selected objects; detect_leaks=0; halt_on_error=1 for UBSan
sanitizer.scope_limit: Linked legacy modules, Qt and external numerical libraries are not fully instrumented. This is not whole-application, GUI or leak validation.

compatibility.saved_method_1_results: Viewable as stored outputs; old workflow method versions are not silently replayed with the new implementation.
compatibility.manifest: schema_version 1 with scope/item marker for item-specific dependency snapshots; source locator metadata is not an immutable source-byte copy.

limitations: No native Windows/MSVC or macOS build, native graphics/input or clean-host package validation in this stage.
Tests cover the listed parameter/data/boundary cases; they do not establish correctness of every possible algorithm or dataset.
Profiling uses many small pairs, not maximum-sized arrays or a universal process RAM cap.
No cross-root/batch join, pair-after-pair grouping, automatic alignment, significance thresholds, MTM cross-spectrum or cross-wavelet.
Final 1.2.0 release packaging/platform acceptance remains pending.
logs: Paths sanitized; status and totals retained.
